speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, at what gestational age are you currently, and are you experiencing any contractions or cervical changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a prior C-section, cessation of contractions upon the onset of bleeding, and severe abdominal pain strongly suggests placental abruption. Given the severity, I need to know immediately if you have passed any clots or felt fetal movement changes. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Coagulation Profile. DIAGNOSIS READY: Placental Abruption
